answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. A ripple of per-task receipts records who did what, and the onyx of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Reaching the yarrow of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
